description: The GUI's whole permission set. `api_call` is the only command it needs, and commands defined by this crate are not capability-gated. The asset protocol is deliberately absent here: it is not a capability permission in Tauri 2, it is `app.security.assetProtocol.enable` in tauri.conf.json plus a scope, and this app sets that scope at runtime because the directory is not known until the engine is open. See src/lib.rs.
